questions.title: Reading log analysis
questions.intro: A reading club records average pages read per day and active reading days. Column D is calculated; column E will show a status.

parts.prompt: Name the best function for total pages read, mean pages per day, and highest pages read in a day.
Write a formula for total pages in D2 from pages per day in B2 and number of days in C2.
Write a SUM formula in D6 for all total pages.
Write an AVERAGE formula for B2:B5.
What is the average pages per day?
Write a COUNTIF formula for pages per day of at least 20 in B2:B5.
What count does this produce?

What status does the first row display?
A club would award prizes only to readers labelled 'On track'. Evaluate this using one table fact, one limitation, one additional piece of data, and a recommendation.
